value.purpose: Every number and unit in the app, tabular figures.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers and dialogs only; work areas stay flat.

motion.name: dur-panel
motion.purpose: Panels opening and closing; nothing decorative during playback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action of a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--fk-accent, #6633f4); color: #fdfcfc; border: none; border-radius: 999px; height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; font: 600 13px/1 'Geist Variable', Geist, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 80ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--fk-accent-strong, #4c1ebc); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9c92ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bordered Button
components.css: .ds-btn-bordered { background: transparent; color: #ece9e6; border: 1px solid #34312e; border-radius: 999px; height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 13px/1 'Geist Variable', Geist, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 80ms; } .ds-btn-bordered:hover { border-color: #8f8a85; } .ds-btn-bordered:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9c92ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Views
components.description: View switcher in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #34312e; border-radius: 999px; background: #131211; } .ds-seg button { background: transparent; border: none; color: #8f8a85; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; font: 500 13px/1.2 'Geist Variable', Geist, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #ece9e6; } .ds-seg .ds-seg-on { background: #ece9e6; color: #131211; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9c92ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Value Field
components.css: .ds-field { background: #131211; color: #ece9e6; border: 1px solid #34312e; border-radius: 8px; height: 32px; width: 80px; padding: 0 8px; font: 400 12px/1 'Geist Mono Variable', 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #9c92ff; }

components.name: Engine Indicator
components.description: Permanent Web or Boost state with latency and load.
components.html: ● WEB 42 ms · CPU 18 % ⚡ BOOST 5.3 ms · CPU 22 %
components.css: .ds-engine { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 12px; font: 400 12px/1.4 'Geist Mono Variable', 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-engine-web { background: #22201e; color: #ece9e6; border: 1px solid #34312e; } .ds-engine-boost { background: #6633f4; color: #fdfcfc; }

components.name: Track Header
components.description: One row per track in the arrangement, at the lane height (44px comfort, 28px compact, resizable per track): colour bar, name, type, M S In letters, meter (dashed M for an implied mute); volume, pan and devices in the inspector of the selected track.

narrative.overview: Faulk looks like a precision instrument: typographic, frank, every control where the hand expects it, labelled in plain words, with a single ultraviolet signal for what matters now. The instrument is dressed in sound matter: soft, grainy gradients that belong to sound only, never to chrome. The site speaks loudly; the app disappears behind the music during long sessions on large monitors.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, ultraviolet, used franchly on the site and as a rare signal in the app (selection, focus, main action, Boost).
Warm neutrals from paper (#fdfcfc) to ink (#131211); no cold greys.
Three families: Archivo (display, wide and black), Geist (interface), Geist Mono with tabular figures (every value: BPM, dB, Hz, positions).
Every state has a glyph or a letter, never colour alone.
Grain is the signature of sound, not a decoration.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Ultraviolet is the only accent. In the app it marks selection, focus, the main action and Boost, nothing else; if two ultraviolet things compete on one screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Glyph Rule
rules.body: No state is carried by colour alone: every engine state has its glyph or letter, the clip indicator adds hatching and a word. Red is reserved for recording and saturation, green for playback, which is why the accent is violet.

rules.name: The Track Is Not A State Rule
rules.body: Track hues name tracks; they never signal mute, solo, selection or error.

rules.name: The Typography As Architecture Rule
rules.body: On the site, giant uppercase titles structure the page; in the app, type becomes discreet and functional, and uppercase is reserved for labels of one to three words.

rules.name: The Mono For Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any value that changes or lines up with others is in Geist Mono with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Room To Breathe Rule
rules.body: Professionals have large screens: show the panels they need side by side instead of hiding them behind tabs, and spend extra width on more timeline, not bigger chrome.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Work areas (timeline, piano roll, mixer) never cast or receive shadows; only things that float above them do.

rules.name: The Square Work Rule
rules.body: Anything the user edits on a timeline or a grid is near-square (2px); roundness signals something you press, not something you edit.

dos: Do keep ultraviolet (#6633f4) for selection, focus, the main action and Boost in the app.
Do give every state a glyph or a letter in addition to its colour, and write CLIP on saturation.
Do set every number in Geist Mono with tabular figures (12px in the app).
Do use the 16 DS-0.1 track hues (the code still ships 8 different, older colours in `web/src/lib/project/tracks.ts`).
Do design for large monitors: comfort density by default (28px rows, 44px lanes), panels side by side, extra width to the timeline.
Do keep grain for sound: sound objects of modules, the site's stage, empty states.
Do keep chrome still during playback; motion in the app is functional feedback under 100 ms (80ms fast, 160ms panels).
donts: Don't set app text in uppercase beyond one-to-three-word labels.
Don't use decorative 3D volumes or grain on chrome, buttons or panels.
Don't animate anything decorative in the app while the transport runs.
Don't use track hues to mean a state, or red and green for anything but recording, saturation and playback.
Don't add shadows to work areas; only floating layers get the float shadow.
Don't name or imitate another DAW in UI copy or design notes.
